records.title: Chlorophyll-A Concentrations (Annual Mean), Annual
records.footnote: Singapore's baseline chlorophyll-a level is less than 30 micrograms per litre.  Data are used for SDG 14.1.1 '(a) Index of coastal eutrophication; and (b) plastic debris density'. Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 14.1.1.
